query:
UPDATE pipeline_tasks
                SET dispatch_started_at = NULL,
                    error_code = 'DISPATCH_FAILED',
                    error_message = $2,
                    status = CASE
                        WHEN attempt_count >= 3 THEN 'FAILED'::pipeline_task_status
                        ELSE status
                    END,
                    completed_at = CASE
                        WHEN attempt_count >= 3 THEN NOW()
                        ELSE completed_at
                    END,
                    updated_at = NOW()
                WHERE task_id = $1 AND execution_arn IS NULL
